unit_check: Identify whether OI is contract count or base currency
method: Compare source metadata, raw fields, and current exact OI unit checks
usable_condition: Unit can be named and remains stable per instrument
failure_condition: Unit cannot be determined or changes silently

unit_check: Assess whether conversion to quote notional is possible
method: Require contract size, mark/index price timing, and no future price leakage
usable_condition: Conversion method is timestamp-safe and documented
failure_condition: Conversion requires future prices or undocumented assumptions

unit_check: Assess whether OI values can be compared across symbols
method: Normalize only when unit and contract denomination are compatible
usable_condition: Cross-market values are interpretable after normalization

unit_check: Check for unit changes over time
method: Scan metadata and discontinuities around contract changes or source schema changes
usable_condition: No unexplained unit breaks or unit breaks are documented and segmentable

unit_check: Compare current exact OI unit with historical route unit
method: Use overlapping timestamp if a future audit permits current/history comparison
usable_condition: Historical route matches exact instrument unit semantics
failure_condition: Historical route appears aggregate or incompatible
